summary: Frontend-only public-URL retest completed. All three iteration_8 fixes passed: duplicate category names render stable charts without React key warnings, CategoryDialog hydrates and rehydrates edited values, and GoalDialog hydrates and rehydrates edited values. Requested regression flows also passed.
seed_data_creation: Used isolated finance_tracker_data_v1 fixtures for duplicate category names, category/goal edits, current and closed-month transactions, recurring automation, auto-save, frequent expenses, notification settings, category/goal cascades, currency, and exports. No backend/shared data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://monthly-budget-313.preview.emergentagent.com. Duplicate-name fixture c1/c2='Duplicada', c3='Otra' produced 3 pie sectors and 12 bar rectangles; switching 2026-08 -> empty 2026-07 -> 2026-08 restored the charts with no 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning. Category edit hydrated Alimentación/5000/#4B8B6B after Add-close, saved Comida, and reopened with Comida. Goal edit hydrated Fondo emergencia/10000/2500/2026-08, saved target 12000, and reopened with 12000. Regression passed for FAB income/expense creation and deletion, frequent expense application, recurring and auto-save mount toasts plus reload idempotency, notifications on/off with granted permission, category cascade, goal auto-save cleanup cascade, USD change, and CSV/PDF downloads.
rca_of_the_issue: The iteration_8 defects are resolved as intended: Dashboard Cell identity now derives from category.id, while CategoryDialog and GoalDialog synchronize form state from the active initial record when opened. No unresolved issue was reproduced.
